heroHeadline: 56th Orbital Mission: Starlink 17-29 (24 Sats, 609th Landing) May 6 — Terafab $55B Chip Facility Filed; SpaceX Public S-1 ~2 Weeks Out
heroSubtitle: 8,766 days of SpaceX milestones — Starlink 17-29 (24 sats, Vandenberg SLC-4E, OCISLY, 44th Starlink-dedicated) is the 56th orbital mission of 2026 and 609th booster landing. SpaceX filed plans for 'Terafab,' a $55B semiconductor facility in Grimes County TX (joint venture with Tesla, Intel 14A chips; $119B total investment potential). Public S-1 IPO filing expected May 15-22 ahead of June 18-30 Nasdaq debut at $1.75T valuation ($75B raise). Starship IFT-12 (Booster 19 / Ship 39 / Block 3 V3) targeting mid-May from OLP-2 Starbase.
